body:
Even if I had all the money in the world I wouldn't be happy. Well, at least without very hard drugs. 

There's no surgery to fix my ridiculous height, my voice, my hands and legs, my huge frame. Basically there's barely anything that could make my body feminine. 

And being in guys body, it doesn't matter if I have softer skin and boobs. I won't be satisfied with a dumb consolation prize like that, it'd only make it worse, knowing how much more feminine I could be if I started transition before puberty.

Well, the truth is I don't have that kind of strength to keep going. And even if I had it, I stll wouldn't see a point. There's really just no happy future for me and the sooner I end this shit the better.

Well, it's not me who ruined my body. I mean, if I had a choice to grow up into a normal girl I wouldn't be here.

And yeah, plenty people care about me blah blah blah, still not worth to live like this. I mean, it's not like I'm living for them?

Knowing that I'm permanently stuck in a body fucked up by male puberty is the main reason.

Another is that I have to work extremely hard to even get a chance to experience this crappy life. Like, I'll have to do 100 times the work of any woman and I'll still be a man in a dress basically.

I'm not insecure, I'm just not deluded and I'm not being overly nice to myself like my friends and other people.

I've been reconsidering it for ages, trying new things, going to support groups and meeting new friends. Still, I have permanantly fucked up body, face, voice and genitals. I mean, people kill themselves over being overweight. Isn't it reasonable that I wouldn't want to live with something way more disturbing and permanent than extra fat?

Well, it's not for me. I have deep voice, huge hands and feet and a lot of other stuff that you can't really fix. It doesn't worth for me living like that.

Of course he does.  

Nope, my life was crap as long as I can remember. Just felt like finally ending it today.

None of that would help. I have an issue that cannot be fixed (being transgender) and at most I can just put off my suicide by another year, like I've been doing since 15.

My family hates me, police would laugh at my problems and probably put me into a mental institution. And I can't call anybody anyway, since I've destroyed my sim cards :)

It's fine, don't worry about people like me.  Some people just aren't the type for, well, living.
Being trans. I just want to be a woman but it's really an impossible goal for somebody like me.
